s: strI, (maGayA yuktaH kAlaH asyAM iti । maGA + “nakzatreRa yuktaH kAlaH .” 4 । 2 । 3 । ityaR NIp .) maGAyuktA pOrRamAsI । yaTA, “puzyayuktA pOrRamAsI pOzI mAse tu yatra sA । nAmnA sa pOzo mAGAdyAScEvamekAdaSApare ॥” ityamaraH । 1 । 4 । 13 ॥ mADI pUrRimA । yaTA, ayoDyAkARqe BarataSapaTe । “AzAQI kArttikI mAGI tiTayaH puRyasamBavAH । apradAnavato yAntu yasyAryyo'numato gataH ॥” vizRuDarmmottare । “pOrRamAsI taTA mAGI SrAvaRI ca narottama ! । prOzWapadyAmatItAyAM taTA kfzRA trayodaSI ॥ etAMstu SrAdDakAlAn vE nityAnAha prajApatiH ॥” sA ca kaliyugAdyA । yaTA, -- “aTa BAdrapade kfzRe trayodaSyAntu dbAparam । mAGe ca pOrRamAsyAM vE GoraM kaliyugaM smftam ॥” asyAM karmmaRo'nantaPala yaTA, mAtsye । “Satamindukzaye puRyaM sahasrantu dinakzaye । vizuve SatasAhasramA kA mA vEzvanantakam ॥” A kA mA vEzu AzAQIkArttikImAGIvESAKIzu । iti tiTyAditattvam ॥ mAGyAM maGAyogABAve siMhasTagurAvakAlapratiprasavo yaTA, SAtAtapaH । “mAGyAM vadi maGA nAsti siMhe gururakAraRam ॥” rAjamArttaRqa dakzaH । “gurO harisTe na vivAhamAhurhArItagargapramuKA munIndrAH । yadA na mAGI maGasaMyutA syAttadA ca kanyodvahanaM vadanti ॥” itTaYca mAGyAM maGAyogABAve'pi SrutiveDAdimaGAsTe'pi gurO Bavati vivAhastu gurormaGAparityAgAdeva । iti malamAsatattvam ॥

kAvyezu mAGaH kavikAlidAsaH ॥” iti prAcInAH ॥ vESAKAdidvAdaSamAsAntargatadaSamamAsaH । maGAyuktA pOrRamAsI yatra mAse saH ॥ tatparyyAyaH । tapAH 2 । ityamaraH । 4 । 1 । 4 । 15 ॥ sa ca triviDaH । makarasTaravyArabDaSuklapratipadAdidarSAnto muKyacAndraH 1 । kfzRapratipadAdipOrRamAsyanto gORacAndraH 2 । makarasTaravikaH sOraH 3 । iti malamAsatattvIyaliKanasvarasAt ॥ tatra jAtaPalam । “vidyAvinItaH svakulapraDAnaH sadA sadAcArayutaH pravIRaH । yogAnurakto vizayezvasakto mAGe'Ta mAse maGavAniveSaH ॥” iti kozWIpradIpaH ॥ * ॥ aTa, mAGakftyam । pAdme । “svargaloke ciraM vAso yezAM manasi varttate । yatra kvApi jale tEstu snAtavyaM mfgaBAskare ॥” mfgo mfgAsyatvena makaraH । tatsTe BAskare । tatra saNkalpaH । aruRodayakAle jale majjanaM kftvA Acamya uttarABimuKaH o~ tat sadityuccAryya kuSakusumatilajalAnyAdAya omadya mAGe mAsi amukapakze amukatiTAvAraBya makarasTaraviM yAvat pratyahamamukagotro'mukadevaSarmmA svargaloke cirakAlavAsakAmo vizRuprItikAmo vA prAtaHsnAnamahaM karizpe iti saMkalpya gaNgAvyatiriktajalamAtre'pi snAnaM karttavyam । pratidinasaNkalpe tu AraBya makarasTaraviM yAvat pratyahamiti na vaktavyaM kintu mAsyanantaraM makarasTe ravAvityaDikaM vaktavyam । cAndrasnAnavAkyantu vESAKakftye'nusanDeyam । tatra saNkalpaM kftvA yaToktaviDinA snAneti karttavyatAM viDAya, -- “o~ duHKadAridryanASAya SrIvizRostozaRAya ca । prAtaHsnAnaM karomyadya mAGe pApapraRASanam ॥ makarasTe ravO mAGe govindAcyuta mADava । snAnenAnena me deva ! yaToktaPalado Bava ॥” ityuccAryya snAyAt । tato vAsudevaM hariM kfzRaM SrIDaraYca smarettataH ॥ “o~ divAkara jagannATa praBAkara namo'stu te । paripUrRaM kuruzvedaM mAGasnAnaM mahAvratam ॥” cAndrasnAne makarArkAspazwakAle makarasTe ravAvityasya na pAWaH । asamavetArTatvAt । tIrTe tu । “mAGamAsamimaM puRyaM snAmyahaM deva mADava । tIrTasyAsya jale nityaM prasIda Bagavan hare ॥” iti paWitvA duHKadAridryanASAyetyAdikaM paWitavyam । gaNgAyAntu padmapurARe । “dine dine sahasrantu suvarRAnAM viSAmpate ! । tena dattaM hi gaNgAyAM yo mAGe snAti mADava ॥” mAnava iti kvacit pAWaH । ekadA saNkalpe tu pratidinasahasrasuvarRadAnajanyaPalasamaPalaprAptikAmaH SrIvizRuprItikAmo vA mAGamAsaM yAvat pratyahaM gaNgAyAM prAtaHsnAnamahaM karizye । iti vAkye viSezaH । pratidinasaMkalpe tu sahasrasuvarRadAnajanyaPalasamaPalaprAptikAmo vizRuprItikAmo vA gaNgAyAM prAtaHsnAnamahaM karizye iti yaToktaviDinA snAnetikarttavyatAM viDAya । “o~ mAGamAsamimaM puRyaM snAmyahaM deva mADava । tIrTasyAsya jale nityaM prasIda Bagavan hare ॥ duHKadAridryanASAya SrIvizRostozaRAya ca । prAtaHsnAnaM karomyadya mAGe pApapraRASanam ॥ makarasTe ravO mAGe govindAcyuta mADaba । snAnenAnena me deva yaToktaPalado Bava ॥” iti paWitvA snAyAt । tataH vAsudevaM hariM kfzRaM SrIDaraYca smarettataH ॥ “divAkara jagannATa praBAkara namo'stu te । paripUrRaM kuruzvedaM mAGasnAnaM mahAbratam ॥” iti paWet ॥ * ॥ skandapurARam । “samprApte makarAditye puRye puRyaprade SuBe । karttavyo niyamaH kaScidvratarUpI narottamEH ॥” tattatpuRyakAmaH SrIvizRuprItikAmo vA iti vAkye viSezaH ॥ * ॥ pOzyAH pOrRamAsyA UrdDvaM mAGapOrRamAsIparyyantaM madirAtulyatvAnmUlakaM na Boktavyam ॥ * ॥ pOzyA UrdDvaM mAGakfzRAzwamyAM CAgamAMsena SrAdDaM karttavyam । mAMsABAve pAyasopakaraRena । tadaBAve kevalAnnena vA SrAdDaM karttavyam ॥ * ॥ aTa rawantIcaturddaSI । “mAGe mAsyasite pakze rawantyAKyacaturddaSI । tasyAmudayavelAyAM snAtA nAvekzate yamam ॥” udayavelAyAM aruRodayavelAyAm । “anarkAByudite kAle mAGe kfzRacaturddaSI । satAravyomakAle tu tasyAM snAnaM mahAPalam ॥ snAtvA santarpya tu yamAn sarbbapApEH pramucyate .” atra tiTikftyatvAdgORacAndrAdaraH । tatroBayadine aruRodayasatArakAle muhUrttAnyUnacaturddaSIlABe pUrvvadine snAnaM yamatarpaRaYca । ekadinamAtre tallABe taddine । mAGasnAnakAlAByantare tAdfSacaturddaSIlABe mAGaprAtaHsnAyinA tantreRa dvayaM kAryyam । tatra o~ tat sadadya mAGe mAsi kfzRe pakze rawantyAM caturddaSyAM tiTO aruRodayavelAyAM amukagotraH SrIamukadevaSarmmA yamAdarSanakAmo gaNgAyAM snAnamahaM karizye iti saNkyalpya yaTAviDi snAnaM prAguktaM caturddaSayamatarpaRaYca kuryyAt ॥ aTa SrIpaYcamI । ‘tatroBayadine pUrvvAhRe paYcamIlABe pUrvvadine lakzmIsarasvatyoH pUjanaM yugmAt । ekadinaprApte taddine । evaM zaqvarzaM SuklapaYcamIvrate'pi । tataSca o~ tat sadityuccAryya o~ madyetyAdi lakzmIprItikAmo lakzmIpUjanamahaM karizye iti saNkalpya SAlagrAme jale vA pUjayet । o~ pASakzamAlikAmBojaSfRiBiryAmyasOmyayoH । padmAsanasTAM DyAyecca SriyaM trElokyamAtaram ॥ gOravarRAM surUpAYca sarvvAlaNkAraBUzitAm ॥ rOkmapadmavyagrakarAM varadAM dakziRena tu ॥ ityanena DyAtvA etat pAdyaM o~ lakzmyE namaH । ityAdinA nEvedyAntena pUjayet । o~ namaste sarvvadevAnAM varadAsi haripriye ! । yA gatistvatprapannAnAM sA me BUyAttvadarccanAt ॥ ityanena puzpAYjalitrayeRa praRamet ॥ * ॥ o~ tat sadityuccAryya omadyetyAdi sarasvatIprItikAmaH sarasvatIpUjanamahaM karizye iti saNkalpya SAlagrAme GawAdisTajale vA pUjayet । “o~ taruRaSakalamindorbiBratI SuBrakAntiH kucaBaranamitANgI sannizaRRA sitAbje । nijakarakamalodyalleKanIpustakaSrIH sakalaviBavasidDyE pAtu vAgdevatA naH ॥” iti DyAtvAvAhya etat pAdyaM o~ sarasvatyE namaH । ityAdinA nEvedyAntena pUjayet । tataH “o~ BadrakAlyE namo nityaM sarasvatyE namo naBaH । vedavedANgavedAntavidyAsTAneBya eva ca svAhA ॥” iti brahmapurARIyena puzpAYjalinA triH pUjayet । matsyasUkte । sarasvatIM saMpUjya । “o~ yaTA na devo BagavAn brahmA lokapitAmahaH । tvAM parityajya santizWettaTA Bava varapradA ॥ vedAH SAstrARi sarvvARi nftyagItAdikaYca yat । na vihInaM tvayA devi ! taTA me santu sidDayaH ॥ lakzmIrmeDA DarA puzwirgOrI tuzwiH praBA DftiH । etABiH pAhi tanuBirazwABirmAM sarasvati ! ॥” iti matsyapurARIyEH prArTya praRamet ॥ * ॥ “banDujIvaYca droRaYca sarasvatyE na dApayet । AcArAt pustakaYca pUjayet । o~ masyADArAya namaH । iti masyADAraM pUjayet । o~ leKanyE namaH । iti leKanIM pUjayet ॥ * ॥ aTa mAGasaptamI । tatroBayadine aruRodayakAle saptamIlABe pUrvvadine ekadine tallABe taddine । aruRodayakAle sAmAnyajale o~ adyetyAdiM sUryyagrahaRakAlInagaNgAsnAnajanyaPalasamaPalaprAptikAma AyurArogyasampatkAmo vAruRodayavelAyAM snAnamahaM karizye । iti saNkalpya yaTAviDi snAneti karttavyatAM viDAya saptavadarapatrARi saptArkapatrARi ca Sirasi niDAya । “o~ yadyajjanmakftaM pApaM mayA saptasu janmasu । tanme rokaYca SokaYca mAkarI hantu saptamI ॥” ityuccAryya snAyAt । tato yaTAkAlaM saptavadarIPalArkapatraSAlitiladUrvvAkzatacandanayuktajalamAdAya omadyetyAdi AyurArogyasampatkAmaH SrIsUryyAyArGyamahaM dade । iti saNkalpya ‘o~ namo vivasvate brahman BAsvate vizRu tejase jagatsavitre Sucaye savitre karmmadAyine ॥’ ityanantaram । “o~ jananI sarvvaBUtAnAM saptamI saptasaptike । saptavyAhftike devi ! namaste ravimaRqale ॥” iti praWitvA idamarDyaM SrIsUryyAya nama ityarGyaM dattvA । “o~ saptasaptivaha prIta saptalokapradIpana । saptamyAM hi namastuByaM namo'nantAya veDase ॥ ityanena praRamet । SUdreRApi snAne tUzRIM viDAnAt snAnamantraM vinA arGyapraRAmamantrAH pAWyAH pOrARikatvAt । gaNgAyAntu bahuSatasUryyagrahaRakAlInagaNgAsnAnajanyaPalasamaPalaprAptikAmo gaNgAyAM snAnamahaM karizye iti vAkye viSezaH । atrArDyadAnamaNgaM etat snAnAdeva mAGaprAtaHsnAnaM tantreREva siDyati ॥ * ॥ aTa viDAnasaptamIvratam । praTamato brAhmaRAn svastivAcya o~ sUryyaH soma ityAdi paWitvA tAmrAdipAtre kuSatilajalAnyAdAya o~ tat sadityuccAryya omadya mAGe mAsi Sukle pakze saptamyAntiTAvAraBya pratimAsIyaSuklasaptamyAM pOzasaptamIM yAvat ArogyasampatkAmo'BIzwatattatPalakAmo vA arkAgrAdItaraBojanavicCittiviDAnena saptamIvratamahaM karizye iti saNkalpya saMyamapAraRasahitaM tattanmAsi tattanniyamaM kuryyAt । tatra mAGe arkAgramAtraM BuYjIta । PAlgune antarIkzagfhItaM kapilAviqyavamAtrapramARaM tadaBAve anyagomayamapIti । cEtre marIcamekam । vESAKe kiYcijjalam । jyEzWe apakvakadalIPalamaDyakaRAmAtram । AzAQe svacCAyadbiguRasamaye yavapramARaM kuSamUlam । SrAvaRe naktaM kAle alpahavizyOdanam । BAdre SudDopavAsaH । ASvene paYcamArdDayAme mayUrARqapramARaM havizyAnnam । kArttike ardDaprasftimAtraM kapilAkzIraM tadaBAve kzArAntaram । mArgaSIrze prANmuKo vAyvaSanam । pOze svalpaM Gftam । tadanantaraYca । “brAhmaRAnBakzayet BaktyA guqakzIranirAmizEH । viprAya dakziRA deyA viBavasyAnurUpataH ॥ azwamyAM pAraRaM kuryyAt kawvamlarahitena ca । mudgamAzatilAdIni GftaYcEva vivarjjayet ॥ ekasidDaM BakzyamuktamarkatantrAnusArataH ॥” cAndramAsaviSezolleKavat anantAdivratavatmalamAsetare tattu karttavyam ॥ * ॥ aTArogyasaptamI । tatra pUrvvavat saptamyAntiTAvAraBya EhikArogya DanaDAnyapAralOkikaSuBasTAnaprAptikAmaH saMvatsaraM yAvat ArogyasaptamIvratamahaM karizye iti saNkalpya pratimAsaSuklasaptamyAM SAlagrAme GawAdisTajale vA pUjayet । raktAmbujAsanamiti DyAtvA etat pAdyaM o~ sUryyAya nama ityAdiBiH saMpUjya । “Aditya BAskara rave BAno sUryya divAkara । praBAkara namaste'stu rogAdasmAn pramocaya ॥” iti triHpUjayet । evaM saMvatsare pUrRe dakziRAM dadyAt । brAhmaRAMSca Bojayet । viSezamAsAnuddeSAdamAvAsyAvratavat malamAse'pi karttavyam ॥ aTa BIzmAzwamI । azwamyAM brAhmaRaH pitftarpaRaM kftvA “o~ vEyAGrapadyagotrAya sANkftipravarAya ca । aputtrAya dadAmyetat salilaM BIzmavarmmaRe ॥” iti pitfvat BIzmaM tarpayet ॥ tataH kftAYjaliH । “BIzmaH SAntanavo vIraH satyavAdI jitendriyaH । ABiradBiravApnotu puttrapOttrocitAM kriyAm ॥” ityanena prArTayet । kzattriyAdiBiH pitftarpaRAt pUrvvaM etat karttavyam ॥ * ॥ BEmyAmekAdaSyAmupozya dbAdaSyAM tilodbarttanamAvaSyakaM karttavyam । snAnatarpaRamahAdAnaBojanAdi yaTAlABaM kuryyAt ॥ * ॥ mAGapOrRamAsyAM yugAdyAtvena pArvvaRaviDinA SrAdDaM karttavyam । anantaPalakAmanayA snAnadAnaYca karttavyam । tasyAM dAnapramARantu tiTitattve'nusanDeyam ॥ iti kftyatattvam ॥ * ॥ * ॥ aTa mAGasnAnaPalam । “bratadAnEstapoBiSca na taTA prIyate hariH । mAGamajjanamAtreRa yaTA prIRAti keSavaH ॥ na samaM vidyate kiYcit tejaH sOreRa tejasA । tadbat snAnena mAGasya na samAH kratujAH kriyAH ॥ prItaye vAsudevasya sarvvapApAdvimuktaye । mAGasnAnaM prakurvvIta svargalABAya mAnavaH ॥ kiM rakzitena dehena supuzwena balIyasA । aDruveRASu heyena mAGasnAnaM vinA Bavet ॥ makarasTe ravO yo hi na snAtyanudite ravO । kaTaM pApEH prasucyeta kaTaM sa tridivaM vrajet ॥ brahmahA hemahArI ca surApo gurutalpagaH । mAGasnAyI vipApaH syAttatsaM sargI ca paYcamaH ॥ upapAtakAni sarvvARi pAtakAni mahAnti ca । BasmIBavanti sarvvARi mAGasnAyini mAnave ॥ pAvakA iva dIpyante mAGasnAtA narottamAH । vimuktAH sarvvapApeByo meGeBya iva candramAH ॥ ArdraM SuzkaM laGu sTUlaM vANmanaHkarmmaBiH kftam । mAGasnAnaM dahet sarvvaM pAvakaH samiDo yaTA ॥ prAmAdikaYca yat pApaM jYAnAjYAnakftaYca yat । snAnamAtreRa tannaSyet makarasTe divAkare ॥ nizpApAstridivaM yAnti pApizWA yAnti SudDatAm । sandeho'tra na karttavyo mAGasnAne narADipa ! ॥ sarvve'DikAriRo hyatra vizRuBaktO yaTA nfpa ! । sarvvezAM svargado mAGaH sarvvezAM pApanASanaH ॥ etadeva paro mantro hyetadeva paraM tapaH । prAyaScittaM paraYcEva mAGasnAnamanuttamam ॥ nfRAM janmAntarAByAsAt mAGasnAnamatirBavet । aDyAtmajYAnakOSalyaM janmAByAsAdyaTA nfpa ! ॥ saMsArakarddamAlepaprakzAlanaviSAradam । pAvanaM pAvanAnAYca mAGasnAnaM parantapa ! ॥ snAtA mAGe ca ye rAjan ! sarvvakAmaPalaprade । te tAMSca BuYjate lokAMScandrasUryyagrahopamAn ॥” iti SrIpadmapurARe uttaraKaRqe 4 aDyAyaH ॥

m: माघ mf(ई)n. relating to the constellation Maghā, ŚārṅgS.; MBh.
माघ m. (scil. मास) the month Māgha (which has its full moon in the const˚ M˚, and corresponds to our January-February), ŚBr. &c. &c.
N. of a poet (son of Dattaka and grandson of Suprabha-deva, author of the Śiśupāla-vadha, hence called Māgha-kāvya; cf. IW. 392 n. 2)
of a merchant, Vīrac.
a: माघः — [मघानक्षत्रयुक्ता पौर्णमासी माघी साऽत्र मास अण्] 1 N. of a lunar month (corresponding to January-February). --2 N. of a poet, the author of the Śiśupālavadha or Māgha-kāvya; (the poet describes his family in Śi. 20. 80-84 and thus concludes: --श्रीशब्दरम्यकृतसर्गसमाप्तिलक्ष्म लक्ष्मीपतेश्चरितकीर्तनचारु माघः . तस्यात्मजः सुकविकीर्तिदुराशयादः काव्यं व्यवत्त शिशुपालवधाभिधानम् ..); उपमा कालिदासस्य भारवेरर्थगौरवं . दंडिनः पदलालित्यं माघे संति त्रयो गुणाः ..; तावद्भा भारवेर्भाति यावन्माघस्य नोदयः Udb. --घी The day of full moon in the month of Māgha.

k.v: पौषे तैषसहस्यौ द्वौ तपा माघेऽथ फाल्गुने। स्यात्तपस्यः फाल्गुनिकः स्याच्चैत्रे चैत्रिको मधुः॥

s: klI, indrasambanDi vastu । maGavata idamityarTe zRapratyayena nizpannam । iti mugDaboDavyAkaraRam ॥ (maGavan + aR । “maGavA bahulam .” 6 । 4 । 128 । iti vikalpAnnatrAdeSaH । tri, yaTA, mAGe । 9 । 25 । “vasuDAntaniHsftamivAhipateH pawalaM PaRAmaRisahasrarucAm । sPuradaMSujAlamaTa SItarucaH kakuBaM samaskuruta mAGavanIm ॥”)
m: माघवन mf(ई)n. belonging to or ruled by Indra, Pāṇ. vi, 4, 128, Sch.
a: माघवन — a. (नी f.) Belonging to or ruled by Indra; ककुभं समस्कुरुत माघवनीं Śi. 9. 25; अवतीतलमेव साधु मन्ये न वनी माघवनी विलासहेतुः Jag.

s: strI, (maGavAn devatA'syAH yadvA, maGavata iyamiti । maGavat + aR । “maGavA bahulam .” 6 । 4 । 128 । iti trAdeSaH । NIp .) pUrvvadik । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥
m: माघवती f. (scil. दिश्) the east, L.
माघवत mf(ई)n. (fr. मघ-वत्) relating or belonging to Indra, Pāṇ. vi, 4, 128, Sch.
a: माघवत — a. (ती f.) Belonging to Indra. --ती The east. --Comp. --चापं the rainbow; U. 5. 11.

m: माघवत—चाप m. ‘Indra's bow’, the rainbow, Uttarar.
माघ—व्याख्या f. N. of Comms. on Śiś.
माघष्टेय m. patr. fr. मघष्टु, g. शुभ्रादि, Kāś.
माघोद्यापन n. N. of wk.

s: strI, (maGavAn devatA'syAH । maGona iyamiti vA । iti maGavan + aR NIp .) pUrvvA dik । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ (indrasambanDini, tri । yaTA, fgvede । 10 । 66 । 2 । “marudgaRe vfjane manma DImahi mAGone yajYaM janayanta sUrayaH ॥” “mAGone maGavata indrasya sambanDini marudgaRe .” iti tadBAzye sAyaNaH ॥)
m: माघोनी (ई), f. (scil. दिश्) the east, L.
माघोन n. bountifulness, liberality, RV.
माघोन mfn. belonging to or ruled by Indra, RV. vi, 43, 4.
माघोत्सव m. the chief festival kept by the Samājes (in commemoration of the founding of monotheistic worship by Rāmmohun Roy on the 11th of Māgha i.e. on the 23rd of January), RTL. 504.

s: klI, (mAGe jAtamiti । mAGa + “tatra jAtaH । 4 । 3 । 25 । iti yat .) kundapuzpam । ityamaraH । 2 । 4 । 73 ॥
v: na॰ mATe BavaM yat । kundapuzpa amaraH ।
m: माघ्य n. the flower of Jasminum Multiflorum or Pubescens, L.
a: माघ्यं — The flower of the kunda creeper.
